title: Hydraulic Power — Green System Reservoir Head Rework and Sight Glass Replacement
abstract: Rework of the green system reservoir head to the anti-extrusion gland standard and replacement of the sight glass by a self-wiping item, removing the fluid film that made visual level checks unreliable.

sections.planning_reason: Line stations report hydraulic staining around the green system reservoir on roughly one aircraft in five at every A check, and the sight glass is often too clouded by the same fluid film to read. Because the level cannot be confirmed, the standard response has become a reservoir replacement, and eleven of the forty-two units removed in a single year tested fully serviceable on the bench. The cause is extrusion of the pressurisation gland at the upper land under thermal cycling.
sections.description: The upper pressurisation gland is replaced by a two-piece arrangement with an anti-extrusion backing ring and the gland land in the reservoir head is machined to a wider groove. The internal transfer pump kit KE634291-03 is retained and its mounting rivets LN745829-02 are renewed. The sight glass is replaced by a borosilicate item with an internal wiper driven by the level float. The main system accumulator NO46703-01 is not changed but its charging line is disconnected for access.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Depressurise the green system and discharge the accumulator. Get access to the reservoir in the avionics bay and disconnect the charging line at the accumulator NO46703-01. Disconnect the hose at the reservoir head. Remove the reservoir head and take out the internal transfer pump kit KE634291-03. Machine the gland land to the dimensions in the accomplishment instructions using the portable tool, or exchange the head for a reworked item. Install the two-piece gland with its backing ring. Replace the sight glass with the self-wiping item and prove the wiper action through the full float travel. Refit the transfer pump kit on new rivets LN745829-02. Install the head and reconnect the hose and the charging line with new seals. Replenish the reservoir using AMM-T-29-10-12-800-002-A and do a leak check at full system pressure. Record the embodiment.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to TITAN-88 aircraft up to and including MSN T00166. Aircraft from MSN T00168 onwards were built with the reworked head. Operators may also take the change at reservoir overhaul rather than on wing, in which case only the sight glass replacement is done on the aircraft.
sections.material_note: Kit K2910-1017-01 contains the gland set, the backing ring, the sight glass and the seal set. Kit lead time is fourteen weeks. Removed sight glasses and gland parts are scrapped locally. The machining tool is loaned by Aeralis on request and is not part of the kit.

type_data.compliance_time: At operator convenience, or at the next reservoir overhaul, whichever occurs first.
